boundary_conditions: dc_dy(0) = concentration_boundary_layer_thickness * contact_attachment_velocity * sticking_probability_new * (idle_fraction + (1 - idle_fraction) * exp(-wall_shear_service / slime_adhesion_strength_new)) / effective_near_wall_diffusivity * c(0)

parameters.name: concentration_boundary_layer_thickness
parameters.justification: Near-wall transport layer of the order of the viscous and buffer sublayer at 12-16 kn.

parameters.name: effective_near_wall_diffusivity
parameters.justification: Effective near-wall transport coefficient of 5-20 um cells (turbophoresis, eddies); time-averaged over service and idle.
